Samantha Ruth Prabhu and Raj Nidimoru host puja for upcoming child

Actress Samantha Ruth Prabhu and her husband Raj Nidimoru held a puja ceremony ahead of welcoming their first child. Prabhu shared pictures from the intimate ceremony, which also included blessings from family elders. She was seen wearing a red suit and showcasing her baby bump.
